title: Realove
tagline: Realove - the dating app care about users, events-based matching and dating plans provided
description: The Realove project, is a mini-app that is build on World chain. We make sure every user on our platform is a real user through World wallet. Other than that, we focus on event-based matching to enhance the dating experience for people who are traveling around the world. Some use cases will be Ethglobal participants or Olympic athletes. Realove users are able to find their match before they arrive to the events, and we provide dating advices for them to explore the city. Users can buy dating packs provided by us to invite their dates out. After the transaction go through an on chain contract, it will give a voucher to user to use at the restaurant.  The dating packs can be paid by multiple currencies, including WLD, ETH, USDC...(LOVE Coin) In the future, we will launch incentives program for people who match with their date and interact with them actively. We provide a free dinner date for them!
how_its_made: We use React/Next.js, Tailwind CSS, world-minikit-sdk, world-mini-apps-ui-kit-react to build our dating app. Especially we implement commands, quick action, UI kit from World in our mini app. We use ChatGPT to help us generate some Ghibli style images for the design. And we use remix to deploy our smart contract on  World Sepolia test net which allow us to mint and manage the NFT for people who are buying our dating pack.
